concept.reason: Necessary actual skeletal and skull photographs establish original nasal-hump gate; no extra concept image.

scope: Whole robust hadrosaur with strongly arched nasal hump on an otherwise uncrested skull; original inventory target maintained.

scientific_limits.en: Artistic whole-animal reconstruction using an exhibited skeletal mount and skull morphology described for RAM6797. The holotype lacks most of its right skull side; complete animal combines inferred missing parts and soft tissue. Photo of Utah mount does not establish its accession or original-bone percentage. Twelve metres is the museum species maximum estimate, not measured specimen length. Colour, skin and pose inferred.
scientific_limits.zh: 根据博物馆装架及RAM6797描述的头骨形态进行完整活体美术复原。正模缺大部分右侧头骨，完整体包含缺失部位及软组织推断。Utah装架照片不证明其馆藏号或真骨比例。12米为馆方物种最大尺度估计，不是该标本实测；颜色、皮肤与姿态属推断。

scale.basis: NHMU species profile estimated upper size, not individual measurement.

diagnostic_targets: Prominent smoothly arched nasal hump anterior to eyes, rising above frontal level.
Very deep robust skull and jaw with steeply ascending anterior beak; not flat Edmontosaurus profile.
No tube, helmet or rear head crest; hump is nasal and continuous with snout.
Heavy trunk, short forelimbs, larger hindlimbs, long tapering tail; complete neutral quadrupedal animal.
Slightly downturned lower jaw anterior end; closed mouth simplifies tooth batteries without claiming toothless jaws.
specimen_basis: Actual Utah mounted skeleton photo and Alf Museum exhibited skull photo viewed. Primary Gates and Sampson2007 describes RAM6797, missing right side, high nasal arch and deep robust skull; no assumption exhibited skull is all original material.
acceptance_checks: Side view nasal arch lies ahead of eyes and reads above skull roof without lambeosaur crown.
Head remains deep, strongly built with steep front beak and stout mandible; not a Maiasaura recolour.
Front view robust head width and complete paired limbs; no ornamental horns or unsupported crest.
Four standard views only; tail and missing anatomy clearly reconstructed.
